push.body:
Hoo-wee, BellyTb1. An 8.3. You played like someone who ate their vegetables.

DID WELL
+ 30 passes. You were the hub, and hubs keep wheels turning.
+ 2 key passes. Making your teammates look good is the most generous thing in football.
+ A goal against FC Creamsters, your 3rd straight match scoring. Never gets old, and I hope it never does.
+ Man of the Match. That's leadership you can't fake.
+ That connection with PhogsToffees is the real deal. Find 'em early and often.

WORK ON
- 6 shots off target cost 0.1. Think of it as a pebble in your boot. Shake it out.
- 2 missed tackles: -0.1. Like leaving the porch light on all day. Small, but it adds up.
- Pass accuracy: 83%. Decent, but top-quarter midfielders get to 87%+. That's the next rung.
- Tackle success: 33%. You're in the neighborhood. The fancy houses start at 50%+.
- Tackles attempted: 3. Solid ground. The best midfielders push it to 6+.

You make this job too easy. Don't tell the gaffer. - Coach Lasso

push.title: D 2-2 vs FC Creamsters | You: 7.5 (above average FOR)
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 7.5 is better than most forwards managed tonight. Let's go find the next gear.

DID WELL
+ 4 shots at FC Creamsters's goal. Can't score 'em if you don't take 'em.
+ 4 of 4 shots on target. On target is half the battle. You won that half.
+ A goal against FC Creamsters. That's the stuff they write songs about. Bad songs, but songs.
+ You and BellyTb1 were on the same wavelength, like two radios tuned to the good station.
+ 1 key pass bought you +0.2. Sprinkles on the sundae.

WORK ON
- 1 goal from 4 on target. Timed finishing only when you trust it. A clean shot to the corner beats a mistimed rocket.
- Pass accuracy: 76%. Respectable. Top-quarter forwards get to 88%+, and you've got it in you.
- Key passes: 1. Middle of the pack for a forward; the top quarter hits 2+. Room to climb.

Coach's drill: Side-foot for accuracy inside the box; power is for outside it.

Ups and downs make a roller coaster, and roller coasters are fun. - Coach Lasso
